section_whoweare.title: Who we are
section_whoweare.subtitle: From vision to reality
section_whoweare.description:
PT. Senang Jaya Abadi moves in the field of hydraulic distributors. In 2009, PT. Senang Jaya Abadi began to build the carpooling of plates, dump trucks, water tanks and loading tanks. With the best quality and materials and supported with the latest technology and worked by a team of experienced experts in its field, thus producing quality products.

Since the beginning, the aspiration of PT. Senang Jaya Abadi is to create quality products so that they can compete in the national market. With the ISO 9001-2008 Quality Management System Certification, the products produced are expected to be more quality and stable. Get all the facilities and services from our company, which we will provide to serve any operational fleet needs, in order to improve the performance and profitability of the company.

our_vision.title: Our vision
content: To become a globally recognized leading automotive and body manufacturing company, through technological innovation, superior product quality, and sustainable contribution to industrial progress and community welfare.

our_mission.title: Our mission
content: Producing high-tech vehicles and automotive solutions that meet international standards, answering evolving market needs, and providing added value to customers.
Providing comprehensive services covering assembly, modification, and maintenance of vehicles and heavy equipment, with a focus on customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement through investment in cutting-edge technology and development of qualified and professional human resources.
Maintaining high standards of quality, safety, and occupational health with compliance with international certifications, and creating a safe and sustainable working environment.

Playing an active role in the development of the national and global automotive industry by strengthening strategic partnerships, creating new business opportunities, and providing positive impacts on communities and the environment.

section_whoweare.title: Siapa kami
section_whoweare.subtitle: Dari visi menjadi kenyataan
section_whoweare.description:
PT. Senang Jaya Abadi bergerak di bidang distribusi hidrolik. Pada tahun 2009, PT. Senang Jaya Abadi mulai membangun karoseri untuk bak plat, dump truk, tangki air, dan tangki muatan. Dengan kualitas terbaik, material unggulan, serta didukung oleh teknologi terbaru dan tenaga ahli yang berpengalaman di bidangnya, kami menghasilkan produk berkualitas tinggi.

Sejak awal, aspirasi PT. Senang Jaya Abadi adalah menciptakan produk berkualitas yang dapat bersaing di pasar nasional. Dengan Sertifikasi Sistem Manajemen Mutu ISO 9001-2008, produk yang dihasilkan diharapkan semakin berkualitas dan stabil. Dapatkan semua fasilitas dan layanan dari perusahaan kami, yang kami sediakan untuk memenuhi kebutuhan armada operasional Anda, guna meningkatkan kinerja dan profitabilitas perusahaan.

our_vision.title: Visi kami
content: Menjadi perusahaan manufaktur otomotif dan karoseri terdepan yang diakui secara global, melalui inovasi teknologi, kualitas produk unggul, serta kontribusi berkelanjutan bagi kemajuan industri dan kesejahteraan masyarakat.

our_mission.title: Misi kami
content: Menghasilkan kendaraan dan solusi otomotif berteknologi tinggi yang memenuhi standar internasional, menjawab kebutuhan pasar yang terus berkembang, serta memberikan nilai tambah bagi pelanggan.
Menyediakan layanan komprehensif yang meliputi perakitan, modifikasi, dan perawatan kendaraan serta alat berat, dengan fokus pada kepuasan pelanggan dan efisiensi operasional.
Mendorong inovasi dan peningkatan berkelanjutan melalui investasi pada teknologi mutakhir serta pengembangan sumber daya manusia yang berkualitas dan profesional.
Mempertahankan standar kualitas, keamanan, dan kesehatan kerja yang tinggi dengan kepatuhan terhadap sertifikasi internasional, serta menciptakan lingkungan kerja yang aman dan berkelanjutan.

Berperan aktif dalam pengembangan industri otomotif nasional dan global dengan memperkuat kemitraan strategis, menciptakan peluang usaha baru, serta memberikan dampak positif bagi komunitas dan lingkungan.
